data.desc: Acadia Healthcare is the largest stand-alone behavioral healthcare company in the United States, providing mental health and addiction treatment services across a comprehensive continuum of care that includes inpatient psychiatric hospitals, specialty treatment facilities, residential treatment centers and outpatient clinics. Acadia operates 280 behavioral health facilities across 40 states and Puerto Rico and serves more than 85,000 patients daily. Guided by its mission, Acadia provides paths to healing through evidence-based treatment and compassionate care that inspires hope, improves lives and elevates communities.
